items.title: Coinbase (COIN) Gets a Path to Tokenized Stocks in the US. But Can It Turn That Into Revenue?
items.summary: On September 17, the SEC approved a temporary framework for trading tokenized US equities. Called the Innovation Exemption, this framework could give Coinbase Global, Inc. (NASDAQ:COIN) a new avenue to expand its “Everything Exchange” beyond crypto. Investor interest in disruptive-growth themes remains active despite recent market volatility. items.title: Standard Chartered Believes Arbitrum Is “Hugely Undervalued” With 70x Upside Potential
items.summary: Standard Chartered just called Arbitrum one of the most undervalued tokens in crypto, but a critical gap between Robinhood Chain's fee revenue and actual ARB holders stands between the bank's bold target and reality.

items.title: Prediction Markets Just Got Another Legal Setback. Robinhood and Sports-Betting Stocks Are in Focus.
items.summary: The Sixth U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals in Cincinnati ruled against prediction-market operator Kalshi on Friday, saying Ohio and Tennessee can apply their gambling laws to its sports-related event contracts.

items.title: Robinhood and Coinbase Are Changing How Investors Buy IPO Stocks
items.summary: Coinbase customers can request shares in Oura’s IPO, while Robinhood has joined the offering as an underwriter. Neither role guarantees investors an allocation.

items.summary: Interactive Brokers is benefiting from increased risk-taking, which could quickly end if a bear market develops.

items.title: What Would You Have Needed To Notice In Coinbase Stock?
items.summary: Coinbase Global (COIN) shares returned 40% over the three months that ended on September 24. A $10,000 holding at the start of that window was worth about $13,980 at the end. The run came even as revenue kept falling. Management had been saying for well over a year that it wanted to go beyond trading, but the latest filed numbers pointed the other way.

items.title: HOOD at the 5-Year Mark: Diversification to Fuel the Next Growth Phase
items.summary: Robinhood's diversification into banking, retirement, active trading and crypto aims to deepen customer ties and reduce reliance on trading activity.
